objCount.description:
Number of objects to generate. This field is considered only when dealing with the root Type.

```js
RandomDataSpec.make({objCount: 100})
```

idPrefix.description:
Defines the numerical range for generated IDs, applicable only to Types that allow user-defined ID ranges.
Not supported by Types with inherently short IDs, like timeseries.

namePrefix.description: Prefix for the generated names. Relevant primarily for the root Type and reference Types.

possibleValues.description:
Specifies the allowable values for generation. This is relevant for primitive Types, external references (used as
IDs), and collections such as arrays and maps.

possibleKeys.description: Defines valid keys for maps, providing structure to the generated data within map collections.

optionalFieldsPercent.description:
Dictates the fill rate for optional fields, as a percentage (0-100). This determines how many optional fields
in root Types, included Types, and their arrays/maps will be populated with values.

arrayAndMapMinSize.description: The minimum size for generated array and map fields. Applies to root Types, included Types, and their collections.

arrayAndMapMaxSize.description:
The maximum size for generated array and map fields. This parameter is used to limit the size of arrays and maps
for root Types, included Types, and their collections.

overrides.description:
Allows for custom specifications of fields, offering flexibility in defining the data generation rules
for root Types, included Types, and their collections.

dataShape.description: Specifies a custom data shape, enabling more detailed and structured data generation patterns.

carbon.description:
A specialized Carbon script designed to generate data. If specified, it overrides all other parameters,
becoming the sole basis for data generation.

title: Random data specification used in {@link GenerateDataSpec#randomData} by {@link Persistable#generateData}.
name: RandomDataSpec
